descriptor: Single-garden tea club with a brewing timer

voice.summary: Steepline sounds like a tea buyer who loves the details but never talks down. It gives temperatures and times as plainly as a recipe and treats the daily cup as a small ceremony.
dos: Give exact temperature and time for every tea
Name the garden and the season
Use sensory words: toasty, floral, malty
donts: Do not use wellness claims like 'detox'
Avoid snobbery about milk or sugar
Never rush the reader towards a purchase

taglines: Wait for the colour to deepen
boilerplate: Steepline Tea Club is a subscription that posts four single-garden teas each month in a tin, with a brewing guide and timer so every cup is steeped at the right temperature.

microcopy.success: Your tin is on its way.
microcopy.error: The timer could not start. Please try again.
microcopy.empty: No blends chosen yet. Pick up to four.

logo.note: A young tea shoot ties the brand to leaf, garden and a slow, living ritual.
